name: io.github.MikkoParkkola/mcp-gateway
title: MCP Gateway
description: Universal MCP gateway with Meta-MCP discovery, routing, and REST API capabilities.

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_ATTESTATION_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Sandbox attestation mode: observe (default, audits only) or off.

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_ATTESTATION_SIGNING_KEY
environmentVariables.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing key shared with bnaut-attestation for sandbox token verification.

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_ATTESTATION_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Signing key id for sandbox attestation tokens (default: gateway).

environmentVariables.name: SYMPHONY_PLUS_ATTESTATION
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable boot-time sandbox attestation enforcement (rollback flag).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_GATEWAY_FIREWALL_SKIP_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated JSON keys exempted from firewall free-text prompt-injection scanning.

environmentVariables.name: NO_COLOR
environmentVariables.description: Set (any value) to disable colored output in `doctor` diagnostics.
